notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (tier 1) throughout, no WAF/bot-protection. Discovery: parsed the homepage's Next.js RSC-embedded Storyblok CMS landing-page registry (182 landing-page definitions) and cross-verified against sitemap.xml (1819 URLs). Genuine site-defined sub-structure: sitewide /new (tags[0]=new, name 'New Arrivals', qty 269) has 8 per-category children, all present in sitemap.xml and all non-zero: Sofas/Chairs/Tables/Beds/Storage/Furniture Sets/Outdoor/Accessories New In. All are real PLPs (browsable Algolia-backed grids with facets/sort, not editorial/lookbook pages) -- verified this is not a marketing landing page by inspecting the embedded results grid and facet breakdown on each. Children's counts do NOT sum to the parent (77+47+32+42+15+55+51+57=376 vs parent 269) -- this is expected overlap, not an error: spot-checked via the sofas/new-in facet breakdown, which shows its 77 hits also carrying facets furniture-sets:28, chairs:14, outdoor:1 (i.e. a modular sofa or bundle item can legitimately carry multiple category tags simultaneously, so category-level children double-count items that also belong to another displayed category), while the sitewide /new listing counts each product once. All counts read from each page's server-rendered Algolia response (index web_product), each flagged exhaustiveNbHits:true, cross-checked via nbPages==ceil(nbHits/24) -- exact in every case. One CMS entry, /accessories/new-in-test, was found in the registry (name 'Shop New Home Accessories', same query as the real /accessories/new-in) but is clearly a draft/test duplicate -- absent from sitemap.xml -- and was excluded. No standalone 'New Collection'-style marketing page was found that needed the ambiguous-collection flag.
